generator: tools/audio/build_audio8.py (procedural synthesis: sfx8.py; same toolkit + loudness conventions as assets/audio .. audio7)

conventions.contract: CONTRACT_GEUMBANG section AR. Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: audio8 (a late fragment, plan §12 G-P6).
conventions.sprite: Every sound lives in ONE audio sprite: audioSprite.keys[key] = [start s, duration s] with 50 ms gaps; Assets.queueAudio loads it once ('__sprite_audio8') and Assets.sliceSprite cuts one AudioBuffer per key (dur + 30 ms) into the audio cache, so Audio.play(key) / exists(key) work unchanged. This manifest is the sprite's JSON (2 files in all).
conventions.groups: Audio.play('sfx_gb_doorbell' | 'sfx_gb_thump' | 'sfx_gb_tape') picks a random variant (never the same twice in a row); the group names are also playable keys (variant 1).
conventions.levels: volume = 10^((target + HEADROOM_DB - measured) / 20), measured on the decoded sprite slice (max momentary LUFS); HEADROOM_DB = -2 like audio .. audio7.
conventions.brand: Original sounds: no voice, no real company's jingle or chime; the 금-방 logo is F5 G5 C6.
conventions.standIn: plan §10.3: until audio8 lands, play standIn (sfx_ticket_chime / sfx_coin / sfx_car_honk_1 / sfx_box_drop) instead.

sfx_gb_doorbell.notes: '띵동' (G5 -> E5): the courier rings at a front door (ring_doorbell impact frame, with fx_gb_bell). Play the group 'sfx_gb_doorbell' (the two houses sound different), positional by distance; once per stop.

sfx_gb_horn.notes: friendly double toy beep of the 금방 van (a van blocked > 6 s, at most once per 6 s; never at night); positional, x0.7 in 관망.

sfx_gb_chime.notes: the 금방 app ping: a new order (only when revealed / the app or toast shows it), a tracker step done while the app is open, the 금방 chip's new dot. UI sound (not positional); at most 1 per 2 s.

sfx_gb_thump.notes: a parcel set down on a snowy doorstep (nobody home: gb_parcel_doorstep), staged by dock 1 (출고 대기), a courier's box landing. Group 'sfx_gb_thump'; positional.

sfx_gb_thump_2.notes: variant: a heavier box that settles with a small scrape (group sfx_gb_thump).

sfx_gb_jingle.notes: the 금방 sound logo '금-방!' (F5 G5 C6, original): the opening ribbon cut, the first delivery of the day, the app's first open / splash. Duck the bgm to 0.5 for 1.2 s; never more than once per game hour except the ceremony.

sfx_gb_tape.notes: packing tape '찌익' (tape_box impact frame at the 포장대). Group 'sfx_gb_tape'; positional / by reveal, x0.8 when two packers work.

sfx_gb_tape_2.notes: variant: a shorter, quicker pull (group sfx_gb_tape).

sfx_gb_scan.notes: soft '삑' per parcel scanned (scan impact frame) and per box loaded into the van; positional, rate 0.98-1.03 so a row of boxes is not a buzzer.

sfx_gb_locker.notes: 금방 보관함 opens (gb_locker open anim, frame 0): latch click, door pop, the two-note chime A5 -> D6; positional.
